meaning.en: Simple past tense and past participle of archive.

sentences.en: The following is an archived copy of a message sent to a Discussion List run by the Campaign Against Sanctions on Iraq.

sentences.en: We are delighted to have been appointed custodians of all the archived original Sentinel drawings.
